visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic list-with-us pages: the ask in the first working surface (SellValueForm, Places autocomplete, pagePath=/sell), live Bend figures with a source trace, one 3% plan with the full Enhanced inclusion list, and every valuation CTA anchored to #get-value. Zero invented results. D11: Value my home on the field submit, never What's my home worth on a control.
note: Migrated off the KB register onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-SELL). Rhythm: no two adjacent sections share a pattern. There is NO cap on how many patterns a page uses (the four-pattern cap was killed 2026-08-27) and the pattern set is OPEN, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb (on-media), Stage (H1 Sell your home in Central Oregon, poster only, 3% listing plan as quiet eyebrow), Sheet-equivalent SellCapture wrapping SellValueForm (capture contract unchanged), Instrument level 2 (Bend pulse, ghost Value my home), V3Sheet (3% plan, Enhanced inclusions, no matrix), Quiet (FAQ + track-record prose + verbatim Google reviews + doors), Footer outside main. The verdict classifies the RAW months-of-supply value and the screen prints formatMonthsOfSupply. Track-record figures do not share the Bend pulse source line. Page-grade v2.4 sell-three-asks: Stage ghost hidden (primitive still requires action), address field empty with visible label, no card title restating the button. Capture is not a deletion: SellValueForm still posts the same payload with pagePath=/sell and formId get-value. CLOSED 2026-08-27: 'Places autocomplete' verified by code trace, not by curl (client-hydrated). Chain confirmed: app/sell/_v3/SellValueForm.tsx renders components/seller-lp/AddressAutocomplete.tsx bound to the address field (visible 'Home address' label, empty value). AddressAutocomplete calls lib/use-google-maps-ready.ts (useGoogleMapsReady({libraries:['places']})) and instantiates google.maps.places.Autocomplete via importLibrary('places') restricted to US addresses, biased to Bend/Central Oregon bounds. The loader is components/GoogleMapsBootstrap.tsx, mounted app/layout.tsx -> RootProvider -> AnalyticsScripts -> GoogleMapsBootstrap (same shared loader used by SearchMapClustered, ListingLocationMap, ListingHeroMap, ListingLot3D, and other live map surfaces). NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set in .env.local. Served SSR markup carries the empty address input with its visible label (curl-verified); the Places wiring itself only activates post-hydration by design, so it cannot be curl-verified and was not expected to be. 2026-09-08 (SITE-02, SITE-10, SITE-05, SITE-11): the address step now ANSWERS before it asks. Order is address -> answer -> contact (email required, phone optional) -> timeframe (the choice is the submit, so a submit cannot land without one) -> success. The near-term lane (ready-now) gets a /book prompt in the success state and in the same-minute system confirmation. address_submit fires on the address step so the address-to-request ratio has a denominator. The old V3Proof reviews band was REMOVED rather than duplicated: V3ProofBlock carries the reviews, directly under the ask, and one reviews surface is the rule (TASTE.md consistency). 2026-09-16 (SITE-111): the first viewport is Stage then THE ADDRESS SHEET. The slab on the photograph is one narrow column — the sourced Bend line with its own section-0 disclosure (SELL_FOLD_TRACE) and a crawlable door to /housing-market/bend, the beui-input address field (components/motion/input, imported by app/sell/_v3/SellValueForm.tsx), the Value my home submit — and the scroll cue moved out of the slab onto the photo. The Bend months-of-supply two-bar LEFT the fold: the 2026-09-12 table called printing city supply beside an untyped address "answering the city before it has a house", and supply is now drawn inside the sheet against the typed street. The submit opens the real shadcn Sheet (components/ui/sheet, Radix Dialog, imported by the same route file) above the chrome — overlay, focus trap, Escape, close control, a three-rung step rail — and the sourced answer reveals inside it between the address and the contact step. Nothing SITE-02, SITE-05, SITE-10 or SITE-11 shipped was removed: the answer step, the sticky ask, the timeframe ask, the proof block and the ask-source attribution are all still here, and the four steps still run address -> answer -> contact -> timeframe -> success with the same payload, field names and pagePath.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: JSON-LD BreadcrumbList + FAQPage. V3Breadcrumb and V3Quiet carry no structured data of their own. FAQPage items are the same FAQ_ITEMS array the Quiet block renders.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home / Sell. tone=on-media because the page opens on a dark V3Stage (ci:kb-breadcrumb-overlay).

requiredComponents.name: V3Stage
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 4, opens the page. headingLevel 1, height tall. H1 is the seo-shell head term. Quiet eyebrow is 3% listing plan. SellCapture + SellValueForm sit on the photograph as the Stage children. The primitive requires an action prop. The page hides it (sell-stage-poster) so the filled primary is the capture submit.

requiredComponents.name: SellValueForm
requiredComponents.section: The ask. Address field is the spine: visible label, empty field, submit Value my home. No card title, no placeholder. Places autocomplete, partial-lead, CMA queue. pagePath='/sell' attribution. formId anchor #get-value. Capture contract unchanged. SITE-02: the ask is now four steps - address -> ANSWER -> contact -> timeframe -> success. The answer body is app/sell/_v3/SellAnswer.tsx, rendered by this form (so the ROUTE does not import it and this contract cannot name it; app/sell/_v3/sell-answer.test.ts is what holds the step in place). It draws months of supply as two bars, the pace and cash readings as sentences with a disclosure each, and the comparable-close count for the typed address. No dollar figure for a typed address (Matt). One component against one data type so the drawing can be swapped.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, level 2. Three lead Bend figures (median, homes for sale, months of supply). Ask is ghost Value my home.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: #bend-also. Extra product types and leftover pace as scannable rows. Count is the figure, the rest of the sentence is detail. Bar-encode type counts only.

requiredComponents.name: V3Sheet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 5, the one 3% plan as plan-detail blocks. No field, no matrix, no 2.5/3.5. Enhanced inclusions only.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6. Seller FAQ as prose from the same FAQ_ITEMS the FAQPage JSON-LD uses, track-record proof as prose with its own MLS closed-sale trace, outbound doors including Value my home and valuationHref('/sell').

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. No button. Rendered OUTSIDE main.

requiredComponents.name: V3ProofBlock
requiredComponents.section: SITE-11. Directly under the ask. The record, the Google reviews in full, and the reach to the ROUTED broker (tel/sms/book from the roster through aboutFaceFromBroker, never a literal - G38). Ships with showOutcomes:false until Matt rules on the two outcome strips; the sell-proof--quiet class collapses the body to one column while the drawing column is empty.

requiredComponents.name: V3StickyAsk
requiredComponents.section: SITE-05. A direct child of main, never inside a hidden ancestor. Watches #sell-hero (sentinel) and #get-value (target): appears once the hero is fully past, retires whenever the address field is on screen. Its verdict tail is built by stickyAskVerdict from the Bend pulse row with applyDetachedOverlay, so it prints the SAME months of supply the Instrument prints.

layoutComponents.name: V3Chrome
layoutComponents.note: Landed E-CHROME. Not remounted on this page.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale and would push the page to five patterns.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: Sold-story cards used to be a third proof rail. Rhythm allows as many patterns as the content needs; only the no-two-adjacent rule binds (the cap was killed 2026-08-27). Proof now lives as Instrument figures plus Quiet prose. A Ledger of sold homes would be a fifth pattern.

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator through the judge chain: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts sell --builder claude-opus-5 --evaluator claude --url http://127.0.0.1:3111/sell --beat 59, ten shots (five states x two viewports) scored three times in the one call (61 / 63 / 66). grok-4.6 was not reachable from this sandbox, so the chain fell to the claude CLI; the route publishes no competitiveBrief, so competitiveBriefPass is not scored here.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs, scale 1, palette-quantized, against `next start -p 3111` on this worktree. default: the page as served. address-focus: --states 'address-focus=#get-value-address!click' (the catalog control's focus state). address-ok: the same tool against /sell?address=61271%20Kwinnum%20Dr,%20Bend,%20OR%2097702 (the SITE-12 homepage hand-off), which opens the field filled, so the catalog control's success check is drawn. address-error: --states 'address-error=#get-value-address!type:abc' --await '.sell-field__error'. answer-open: --states 'answer-open=#get-value-address!type:61271 Kwinnum Dr, Bend, OR 97702' --await '.sell-answer' — the shadcn Sheet open over the photograph with the sourced answer for the typed street inside it.

tasteReview.beats: Redfin's home-value estimate flow: this page wins on showing sourced, dated local market context (the months-of-supply bar pair, the days-to-pending scrubber, both with a how we calculate this disclosure) inside the same flow before any contact detail is asked for, which the portals gate behind lead capture. It loses on the input itself: Redfin's address field has visibly richer live autocomplete motion than this bordered box.

defects.finding: The four captured states (idle, focus, success check, error) show only a border-colour change and a static checkmark or error line appended to a conventional labelled input. The beui Motion Input demo's defining behaviour is the label's morph into the field; here the label never leaves its position above the box in any shot, so a visitor cannot tell this is anything but a repainted native input.
defects.builderNote: Recorded as returned and NOT acted on, because the premise is checkable and false: components/motion/input.tsx — the installed catalog source, which ci:catalog-install verifies and both the route file and components/site/v3/V3Input.tsx import — renders its label as a static <label> above the field. There is no floating-label morph in the demo to reproduce. What the demo does carry is in these shots: the label slot, the left affix, the focus state, the drawn success check, the reserved error message row; its shake and its check's path draw are motion and cannot appear in a still. The repaint to square corners, a navy rule and a warm-stone ring is CLAUDE.md section 3, not a cream box. Left open rather than answered by adding a behaviour the catalog does not have.

defects.finding: "Please enter a complete property address." renders at roughly the same weight as the helper copy elsewhere on the card, so a visitor could miss that anything changed.

defects.section: hero card (3% LISTING PLAN / Sell your home in Central Oregon)
defects.finding: The fold leads with agency copy over the stat line, while the page's actual claim — Bend is a seller's market right now, backed by the 614-vs-175 comparison — is inside the sheet. The most sourced content on the page is invisible until a visitor completes an address.

A bare number (17), one testimonial and three flat outlined controls in three columns is the proof-block shape any brokerage site uses; nothing in the composition is a choice a template would not also make.

tasteReview.verdict: The sheet is the real gain: a sourced, verdict-consistent months-of-supply bar pair and a days-to-pending scrubber that reward the interaction, which is why this scores above the prior mark. Honesty rises to 9 — the fold's figures now carry their own section-0 disclosure, and the source row that read "months of supply 3" beside a 3.5-month verdict now reads 3.5. demoMatch came back false on the address field and is recorded as returned; the node stays in_progress. The fold that gets seen first is still a stock sell-your-home card and a conventional proof column.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel (claude-sonnet-5, not grok-4.6) and rubricVersion (v1-2026-09-12, not v1-2026-09-10) both differ from the mark committed at HEAD: grok-4.6 is not reachable from this sandbox and the judge chain fell to the claude CLI, which is a different instrument. The honesty criterion rose against both comparable readings — 9 here against the HEAD receipt's 7 and the 2026-09-12 grok table's 8 — so the product hold is met on its own terms rather than by the rebaseline. Not a fall from the HEAD 61: a first mark on a new instrument.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason.
